headline: FICO Joins Marsai Martin's Foundation and Seeds of Fortune Inc. to Expand National Financial Empowerment Initiative for Families and College Students
summary: Seeds of Fortune Inc. and Marsai's Way Foundation are deepening their partnership to advance financial empowerment, building on a successful inaugural year that reached more than 2,000 students with financial education, college readiness, and community engagement programming.
